title: Hearty Flaky Dutch Kielbasa Pastry
description: A rich and flaky Dutch dish featuring kielbasa, perfect for a satisfying meal, and can be made gluten-free friendly with some adjustments.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large skillet, cook the sliced kielbasa over medium-high heat until browned, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the chopped onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
Deglaze the skillet with beer and chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the cooked kielbasa back into the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Spoon the kielbasa mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg and fold the other half of the pastry over the filling.
Press the edges of the pastry to seal and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet and brush the top with the remaining egg.
Bake the pastry in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
